mobility_diagnostic.interpretation: Strict mobility is used for physical acceptance. The relaxed result is diagnostic only and is not used to compute reactions or declare uniqueness.

normalized.formula: max body force residual / total weight; max body moment residual / (total weight * max COM distance from world interface)

yaw_gravity_audit.interpretation: Vertical-axis yaw should not change gravitational potential; a nonzero derivative indicates an unconstrained orientation/gauge or kinematic inconsistency.

blockers: 严格销轴—移动副速度约束矩阵的自由度为 0，而不是预期的 J2/J3/J4 三个自由度。
三根推杆总广义驱动力矩在严格矩阵右零空间下仍非唯一，J2/J3/J4 重力虚功验收失败。
约 1e-6 相对阈值下才出现三个近零运动模态，说明源数据的小量几何不一致足以破坏严格速度兼容性；该阈值仅作诊断，未用于反力或唯一性判定。
physical_acceptance.next_action: 复核三处移动副轴线与六处真实销轴的 CAD 局部轴向/安装偏置；在不投影硬点、不放宽物理验收的前提下恢复严格三自由度后再重算。
